title: Data Scientist
description: Analyze structured data with Python, pandas and NumPy. Build machine learning models using scikit-learn, evaluate model performance, and communicate findings through data visualization. Use statistics, feature engineering and SQL to answer business questions.
skills_desc: Python, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, SQL, machine learning, statistics, data visualization

title: NLP Engineer
description: Build natural language processing applications in Python. Clean text, develop TF-IDF features, compute cosine similarity, and evaluate content-based recommendation systems. Use pandas and scikit-learn to explain model outputs and experiment with text classification.
skills_desc: Python, natural language processing, TF-IDF, scikit-learn, pandas, machine learning

title: Data Analyst
description: Clean and analyze datasets with SQL, Python and pandas. Create data visualization reports, investigate trends, document business definitions, and communicate clear results to stakeholders. Experience with Excel, Tableau and statistical analysis is useful.
skills_desc: SQL, Python, pandas, Excel, Tableau, data analysis, data visualization

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Develop Python machine learning pipelines using scikit-learn and NumPy. Prepare data, perform feature engineering, train and evaluate models, and collaborate on reliable deployment. Work with Linux, Git and cloud services to support reusable model workflows.
skills_desc: Python, scikit-learn, NumPy, machine learning, Linux, Git, cloud

title: Data Engineer
description: Build reliable data pipelines with Python, SQL and Apache Spark. Design ETL workflows, validate data quality, maintain PostgreSQL tables, and support analytics teams. Use Airflow and cloud storage to schedule repeatable data processing tasks.
skills_desc: Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Airflow, PostgreSQL, data engineering

title: Network Engineer
description: Design campus networks using Cisco, MikroTik and Juniper equipment. Configure VLANs, DHCP, DNS, firewalls and wireless access points. Troubleshoot connectivity, document network changes, and monitor availability with Nagios and Observium.
skills_desc: Cisco, MikroTik, Juniper, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, Nagios, Observium, Linux

title: Systems Administrator
description: Administer Linux and Windows Server environments. Maintain virtualization, backups and patching, investigate incidents, and automate tasks with shell scripting. Support users, document procedures, and monitor systems with Nagios and Observium.
skills_desc: Linux, Windows Server, virtualization, shell scripting, Nagios, Observium

title: Cloud Support Engineer
description: Support Microsoft Azure services, Linux systems and cloud collaboration tools. Troubleshoot identity access, administer Google Workspace, and communicate clearly with users. Use shell scripting, monitoring and documentation to resolve service issues.
skills_desc: Azure, Linux, Google Workspace, shell scripting, technical support

title: Security Analyst
description: Monitor systems for security incidents, review firewall events, and support incident response. Perform Linux hardening checks, document risk assessments, and help maintain governance and compliance practices. Use Python and network knowledge to investigate alerts.
skills_desc: Linux, Python, firewalls, incident response, governance, compliance

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Transform data into clear business reports using SQL, Excel and Power BI. Validate datasets, analyze performance trends, design dashboards, and explain findings to nontechnical teams. Work with Python and pandas for repeatable data preparation.
skills_desc: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Python, pandas, data visualization
